Pump & Motor: Supply & delivery at site Kirloskar/Sam Turbo/Jyothi/M &P/ WPIL/Beacon Weir/Flow more or any other make approved by the Board mono block submersible pump set confirming to IS 8034-2000 specifications, to work site with testing of as per instructions of engineer incharge of work and latest amendments etc. complete. and the following descrption:
a) Duty condition: Min. 25HP or Suitable HP  Capable of delivering of 20LPS/ of Treated water  against a total head of 60-80mtrs. Including suction  lift of 3 mtrs 
b) Speed: Duty condition should be met at 1460 RPM.
c) Shutt off head: Min 110% & Max 130% of the specified head
d) Minimum Efficiency: 76%.
i) Casing  cast Iron.  ii) Impellor- CF 8 M  iii) Shaft-Stainless steel shaft-SS 410  iv) Stuffing Box- Graphite Asbestos packing   v) Wear rings- Phosphor Bronze vi) Gland-Cast Ir vii) Inter stage ring Phosphor Bronze  viii) Shaft sleeve & nuts- Bronze  ix) Neck ring - Bronze  f) Driving end bearing: Grease lubricated roller/ball/journal  g) Non driving end bearing: Grease lubrcated deep groove h) Coupling: Suitable size vibration proof flexible coupling
i) Base plate: Heavy duty common CI/MS base plate for pump and motor wth suitable 'I' section girders, channels, plates, bolts & nuts etc.
NOTE: (1) The duty point of the pump should be to the left of the BEP.
2) The pump is required to work at an altitude of 550.00 mtr. above MSL and at a max, ambient temperature of 450 C
(1.1) Motor:-
a) Protection: IP 55  b) Insulation: 'F' class c) Ambient temperature: 450C  d) Cushion: 10% more than power required by the pump and capable of providing rated output upto + or 10% voltage variation and/or + or -3% frequency variation or combination  e ) Driving end bearng: Grease lubricated roller bearng
f) Non driving end bearing: Grease lubricated ball bearing
etc., complete with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in Charge ---- All Terms and conditions as per uploaded Bid document

The pipe should be tested as per IS 3589 / 1996.  The welding should be done as per IS 2825-1969.  The thickness of flanges should confirm to IS 6392 - 1971.
